ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure is a bar chart of the industrial output value structure of four cities in industrial sectors such as steel, machinery, chemicals, aircraft, automobiles, electronics, textiles, and others. According to the legend, city 2 corresponds to the bar shape with a dotted pattern. Read the bar characteristics of city 2: the proportion in the “steel” sector is relatively high, about one third; the proportion in the “textiles” sector is also very high, about 30%; while the proportions in technology or equipment manufacturing sectors such as “automobiles,” “electronics,” and “aircraft” are relatively low or close to none. Then infer: The four candidate cities are Detroit, Xi'an, Kolkata, and Munich. Kolkata is a traditional industrial city in India; traditionally, sectors such as steel and textiles are relatively prominent, while the proportion of advanced manufacturing is relatively low. This matches the industrial structure of city 2 most closely. Therefore, city 2 is Kolkata.
